chatParticipants.name: jira
chatParticipants.description: Manage Jira tickets with natural language

chatParticipants.name: bitbucket

commands.title: Ticket Sidekick: Set Personal Access Token
Ticket Sidekick: Configure Bitbucket Cloud Credentials

ticketSidekick.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your Jira instance (e.g. https://jira.mycompany.com)

ticketSidekick.authType.description: Authentication mode: 'datacenter' uses Bearer PAT, 'cloud' uses Basic email:apiToken

ticketSidekick.requiredFields.description: Field names that must be set for ticket validation (e.g. ["assignee", "priority"])

ticketSidekick.defaultProject.description: Default Jira project key (e.g. 'VSJI'). Used when creating tickets if no project is specified in your prompt.

ticketSidekick.apiVersion.description: Jira REST API version. Set to 2 if your server does not expose /rest/api/3 (common on older Data Center instances).

ticketSidekick.showConnectionInfo.description: When enabled, each @jira response starts with an italic line showing the active base URL, API version, and auth type.

ticketSidekick.bitbucket.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your Bitbucket Data Center instance (e.g. https://bitbucket.mycompany.com). Leave empty for Bitbucket Cloud.

ticketSidekick.bitbucket.authType.description: Bitbucket authentication mode: 'datacenter' uses Bearer PAT, 'cloud' uses Basic email:Atlassian-apiToken
